violation_type.title: Operation and Program Director Annual Training-Less than 5 years experience management, supervision, and leadership (26 TAC §744.1311(e)(1))
violation_type.short_title: Operation and Program Director Annual Training-Less than 5 years experience management, supervision, and leadership
violation_type.typical_finding: The following trainings were not available for review for the Operation Director:  1.Preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction.  2.Handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials including compliance with ?744.2523 of this chapter (relating to Must caregivers wear gloves when handling blood or bodily fluids containing blood?).
